name: ZCA_IMPORT_PROPERTIES
description: Table will save the different properties which will be used by Import

columns.name: IMPORT_PROPERTY_ID
columns.description: Primary Key for the table ZCA_IMPORT_PROPERTIES

columns.name: CONFIG_NAME
columns.description: Configuration name which will be saved in table

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Property Name which will be saved in the table

columns.name: VALUE
columns.description: Value for the property created is saved in this column

columns.name: REF_TABLE
columns.description: Name of the table against which this property refers to

columns.name: START_TM
columns.description: Start Tm indicates the time when the property row was created

columns.name: END_TM
columns.description: End Tm indicates the time when the property row was updated

columns.name: PROPERTY_FLAGS
columns.description: Will store the type of the property

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
